programme.title: The Hobby
programme.desc: A McDonald’s Happy Meal shortage. A security guard escort. Guns pulled in a Target parking lot. All of these are caused by a common factor: trading cards. In 2020, a new BOOM began. For the first time, large hedge funds, celebrities like Logan Paul and Steve Aoki, nostalgic millennials, entrepreneurs like Josh Luber, and billionaires scrambled to add sports, Pokémon, and other hot item cards to their collections and portfolios. Over the next two years, the hobby exploded — even causing card grading services to shut down due to overwhelming customer service. This documentary is a character-driven feel good deep dive into the high-stakes, eccentric world of card collecting, following buyers, sellers, card shop owners, graders, online streamers, auctioneers, and more, who all participate in the hobby in their own unique ways. Directed by Morgan Jon Fox.

programme.title: Lewis Hamilton: The Winning Formula
programme.desc: As the only black Formula One driver in history, Lewis' journey to becoming the most decorated Formula One driver in history, is one of dreams, courage, and determination. Directed by Piers Garland.

programme.title: Kobe Bryant: A Tribute
programme.desc: The sudden and tragic passing of Kobe Bryant, alongside his young daughter Gianna left the world in a stunned silence. Never before has a sporting star held such high esteem outside of their profession… But Kobe Bryant was a superstar. Unmatched on the basketball court and cherished on the red carpet– Kobe’s dedication to his career, his family and his charity work led to him being adored the world over. Directed by Danielle Winter.

programme.title: Kid Yamaka
programme.desc: This deeply human story explores boxer Zachary "Kid Yamaka” Wohlman’s difficult past, his training under world-class coach Freddie Roach, and his path to personal redemption through boxing, Judaism, and sobriety. With Zachary’s 2021 passing, this film serves as a moving tribute to his hustle, heart and soul and to all those who struggle with addiction. Directed by Matt Ogens.

programme.title: Strike
programme.desc: Bill Fong is passionate about bowling. One seeming ordinary night all may change for this underdog as Fong begins to get strike after strike, nearing the ever elusive 'perfect series.' Directed by Joey Daoud.

programme.title: We Are Oscar Mike
programme.desc: Through his non-profit foundation, Oscar Mike, Noah helps rehabilitate other veterans through the adaptive sports that saved his own life. Directed by Nick Cavalier.

programme.title: Osama & Ayman
programme.desc: Osama and Ayman Abdeldayem skate through the streets of our nation's capital, while navigating growing Islamophobia with style and humor. Directed by Ben Mullinkosson, Sam Price-Waldman, and Chris Cresci.

programme.title: Forensics: Operation Drake
programme.desc: Two males visit a New Plymouth house in the middle of the night, staying only a few hours before they leave. The following day the occupants discover what they think is a body left in the garage. Police are called.

programme.title: Forensics: Operation Keppel
programme.desc: An abandoned car is discovered in a quiet Hamilton street. Police are called and they find an envelope with money in it, an IOU note and a suitcase with women’s clothing in it. They trace the car’s owner as a young mother, Carmen Thomas, who lives in Auckland and hasn’t been seen for several days. Her ex-partner, Brad Callaghan, says that she missed a scheduled pick up of their young son and that he is concerned for her well-being.

programme.title: Forensics: Operation Nadia
programme.desc: At 7.30am on a mild, summer morning, a middle-aged woman goes into her backyard to unlock the self-contained unit where her 23-year-old daughter lives alone. She lets her daughter’s dog out and notices a pair of overalls lying on the floor, half-in, half-out of the bedroom. The overalls should be with her daughter who, by now, would normally be on her way to work at a recycling facility. The woman takes a closer look and finds her daughter’s body lying face-down on the bedroom floor, cold. She calls out to her husband, they phone emergency services and the operator tells them to roll over their daughter - her throat has - been cut.

programme.title: Forensics: Operation Edgewater
programme.desc: At 1.20am on a dark rainy Sunday morning the residents of a suburban street are woken by the sounds of a taxi crashing into a brick fence. There was no squealing of brakes. A witness rushes to help and finds the driver slumped over the steering wheel. He is bleeding profusely from wounds in his neck and chest, his foot is still pressing the accelerator, the engine still running.

programme.title: Forensics: Operation Davis
programme.desc: A teenage girl is dropped back at her family home at around 6pm on a Saturday evening after an overnight visit to a friend’s house. Her mum was away visiting relatives; her sister is due back home at 8am the next morning. She texts her sister to let her know she is safely home and spends the evening texting friends until just after 10pm. This is the last - time anyone ever hears from 15-year-old Marie Davis.

programme.title: Call The Cops: Juggling Chainsaws
programme.desc: It's the Easter Bank holiday in Devon and Cornwall, when the force’s Control Rooms must deal with over a thousand incidents a day with a overstretched crew of frontline officers.

programme.title: Call The Cops: Dark Times
programme.desc: In this episode, we see the effects of a changing Britain three years after Brexit, a political event that divided the nation.

programme.title: Call The Cops: No Going Back
programme.desc: Since 2017 Devon and Cornwall Police are dealing with over 18,000 extra 999 calls, with mental health related incidents now accounting for 40% of their workload.

programme.title: Call The Cops: Breaking Point
programme.desc: "This is the worst time I have ever known…if we had more police, they wouldn’t be able to get away with it so easily,” says convenience store owner Colleen, after being robbed for the fifth time in a - little over a year.

programme.title: Call The Cops: Random Acts
programme.desc: This episode, Random Acts, filmed over just one weekend with Devon & Cornwall police, highlights the extraordinary pressure they’re under.

programme.title: Call The Cops: Episode 2.2
programme.desc: It’s Friday morning, just after dawn in a secluded Cornish harbour and a member of public has reported seeing a tiny boat unload an unusual cargo into an awaiting Luton van.

programme.title: Call The Cops: Episode 2.3
programme.desc: This is the story of two very different manhunts. One case involves a car, traveling at over 100mph which has flipped off the road and hit a tree.

programme.title: Abundance
programme.desc: During the largest food crisis in a century, a group of college students catalyze a national movement to end food insecurity in the U.S. Directed by Owen Dubeck.

programme.title: Wildfire
programme.desc: Nicola is a natural winemaker living in a remote village near Crotone, where his atavistic pursuit of wine is under active siege from climate related wildfires and the prolonged dry seasons. - For Nicola, and other winemakers like him, this environmental change has existential consequences; it threatens his livelihood. “Wildfire” patiently observes Nicola in this affective state of anxiety—as the wildfire grows within him—as he’s forced to alter the course of his harvest in real time. Directed by Andree Ljutica.

programme.title: Blood, Sweat and Beer
programme.desc: Blood, Sweat, and Beer follows a trio of 23-year-olds as they struggle to start The Brew Gentlemen Beer Co. in Braddock, PA., a once-prosperous steel town hoping to bounce back from decades of neglect, violence, and population loss. The film also follows Danny Robinson, a boardwalk brewery owner whose business is threatened by an aggressive trademark lawsuit that could leave him bankrupt. Directed by Chip Hiden and Alexis Irvin.

programme.title: Future Forward - Future Of Farming
programme.desc: Climate change brings unprecedented heavy rains that take inches off topsoil, destroying farmers’ harvests and threatening their livelihoods. Learn how midwestern farming advocacy group, Practical Farmers of Iowa, worked with consumer goods company, Unilever, to tackle this issue head on. Directed by Laura Checkoway.

programme.title: Pickle Man
programme.desc: Facing certain death by ALS, Arthur Cohen decides to leave a legacy of pickles. PickALS, that is. Arthur is brilliant, hilarious and courageous in this intimate portrait of a man facing a brutal disease. Directed by Nastasya Popov.

programme.title: Bloody Nose, Empty Pockets
programme.desc: On the eve of the 2016 U.S. presidential election, and on its final night before closing, a Las Vegas dive bar becomes a stage where its employees and barflies commiserate one last time. Directed by filmmaking brothers Bill and Turner Ross.

programme.title: Caffeinated
programme.desc: Learn the story behind your morning Joe. From seed to mug, coffee, and the process by which it is created, has shaped the lives of thousands of individuals worldwide. Caffeinated gives the coffee consumer unprecedented access to the farmers responsible for growing that perfect bean, and the roasters and baristas responsible for brewing that perfect cup. Directed by Vishal Solanki.

programme.title: Elvis & Priscilla: Conditional Love
programme.desc: Elvis and Priscilla are one of the most famous celebrity couples of all time. But the story that lies beneath the glamorous facade is more toxic than what first meets the eye. Elvis has defined Pricilla's life. His comment that she was "young enough that he could train her any way he wanted,", in the end, came true. Though their relationship was bound by true love, what were the conditions that let it flourish? Directed by Finlay Bald.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Days
programme.desc: Germany is in decline. Once the world's most powerful country is now being devastated by WW2. Adolf Hitler has gone into hiding. The dreaded ruler is no longer openly supporting his people. He is slowly losing his mind. This documentary gives insight into the last days of Hitler’s life as well as his death. With expert contributors like Guy Walters and Dr. Lisa Pine, this project uncovers an intriguing perspective on history. Directed by Daria Tuca.

programme.title: Killed Walking Home
programme.desc: Every three days, a woman is killed in the UK. These women could be sisters, daughters, and friends. Although there is a lead that breaks open the case - what comes in light of the investigation is one that leaves an everlasting scar on the families.Directed by Afsheen Hussein, Jordan Hill, and Brian Aabech.

programme.title: Equipo De Investigacion
programme.desc: Equipo de Investigación analiza en el reportaje Efecto Tiktok, la aplicación más descargada de este último año en todo el mundo. Cuenta con 1.000 millones de usuarios y el 28 por ciento son menores de edad.

programme.title: Policías en Acción
programme.desc: Una madre que trafica droga junto a sus hijos menores. Los agentes valencianos detienen a un joven que presuntamente estaba maltratando a su novia. Agentes desarticulan una red de atracadores.

programme.desc: Una noche de verano de 2004, el alcalde de una pequeña pedanía de Burgos es asesinado a puñaladas en su domicilio, junto a su mujer y su hijo pequeño de 12 años.

programme.desc: Nos introducimos en La Victoria, una de las prisiones de hombres más duras y con mayor hacinamiento de Centroamérica. Construida para 800 presos, malviven 8000, siete de ellos españoles.

programme.title: En Tierra Hostil

programme.title: War Crimes of the Liberators
programme.desc: US soldiers fought for democracy and the freedom of other nations. Yet in the course of military operations, they too committed war crimes. Most of them never followed up on let alone punished. In the wake of the Allies’ advance against Hitler’s tyranny, there were numerous atrocities committed by the victors, not only in the East. Apart from their medals, some American soldiers also kept a dark secret. GIs killed German Prisoners of War and raped thousands of German women. Estimates of the number of German victims vary widely, and are highly disputed among experts. Not least because they touch on a taboo, since for decades in Germany the subject had been considered as a potential strain on the relation between the Federal Republic of Germany and its Western Allies. According to some historians there were several thousand sexual assaults by American soldiers in Bavaria alone when US forces liberated the region in April 1945. At some invasion beaches in Normandy, only every second germen POW survived. Often, the liberators – shocked by the sight of German atrocities – would fall into a spiral of violence. Very few of these crimes came under investigation by US military courts. Studies by the US War Department hinting at a comparatively high number of transgressions were classified secret.

programme.title: Crime Scene Eulau - The Mystery of the 13 Skeletons
programme.desc: This documentary focuses on a spectacular discovery made in a quarry near the village of Eulau, not far from the central German town of Naumburg. Neolithic graves contained the skeletons of three women, two men and eight children, buried tenderly 4500 years ago, some affectionately entwined. In 2008, for the first time anywhere in the world, it was possible to perform a DNA analysis on the earliest evidence of the existence of a nuclear family. This was a sensation - but why did these people all die at the same time? Were they the victims of a violent crime? Who were they, and how did this terrible drama unfold? Archaeologists insist that these victims will not be forgotten, since these days it is possible to do far more than simply date and record such finds. Modern scientific methods have revolutionised archaeology, enabling us to discover how and why the family from Eulau in the German state of Sachsen-Anhalt died 4500 years ago. By enlisting the help of a CID profiler, archaeologists and anthropologists employ state-of-the-art analytical methods to investigate this Stone Age crime. In the process we discover key information about an era before recorded history which has previously been shrouded in mystery - and astonishing information about the composition of the population here also comes to light. It seems that the third millennium before Christ saw two major waves of migration, from Eastern and Western Europe, which determine the composition of the population here. In the middle of what is now Germany these two migratory movements met. Could this be the background to the mysterious murders of Eulau?

programme.title: Scotland - Highlands and Islands
programme.desc: Mysterious castles overlooking lonely lakes, and men in kilts playing the bagpipes; whiskey, and the Loch Ness monster: everybody is familiar with the clichés about Scotland. What few people realise, however, is that Great Britain‘s northernmost region also contains fascinating countryside and wildlife.

programme.title: Eagle Lakes
programme.desc: The Lauenburg Lake District is located between Lübeck and Lauenburg on the River Elbe. With more than 470 square kilometres, it is the third largest natural reserve in Schleswig-Holstein. Due to its extensive forest areas, 40 lakes and its proximity to Mecklenburg’s biosphere reserve Lake Schalsee, it forms the largest protectoral area alongside the former inner-German border.

programme.title: World War A - When Aliens Attack
programme.desc: Scientists are already looking feverishly for evidence of extraterrestrial life. With the ExoMars mission, ESA will soon find life on Mars. If there are only tiny microbes, there could also be life in other places in the universe. But can life in space exist at all? The exobiologist Jean-Pierre de Vera collects microorganisms around the world and tests them in his Mars simulation laboratory. Can they survive under the deadly conditions of Mars? Researchers believe there are planets on which alien life can exist. In 1991 the Swiss astrophysicist Michel Mayor discovered the world's first exoplanet. Since then, about 3,000 planets have been detected outside our solar system. Heike Rauer from the German Aerospace Center is looking for habitable planets. Will she find a second earth? The European Southern Observatory is also searching for life in space, building the largest telescope in the world. In the next 20 years the E-ELT should be able to prove the existence of life on distant planets. How would extraterrestrials look? Some scientists suspect that they may well resemble us humans. Under other environmental conditions, alien life could also arise completely differently. It could be formed from methane and silicon. Different gravity would form alien bodies completely differently. Could extraterrestrials send us messages? At the SETI Institute in California, alien hunters like Seth Shostak are listening to signals from alien civilizations. But mere listening is no longer enough. Some SETI researchers now want to send messages to the aliens themselves. They hope to finally get an answer. But would that be a bad idea? Many scientists warn of the dangers of establishing contact. The former SETI researcher and science fiction author David Brin also fears that it could be a devastating mistake. With well-meant news we could end up attracting attention from hostile civilizations. Should we really tell them that we exist and where they can find us?

programme.title: Wild Hungary - A Water Wonderland
programme.desc: "Wild Hungary - A Water Wonderland" is a wildlife documentary about a white-tailed eagle family, a young otter and a giant catfish that share the wetlands of this country in Central Europe. Hungary lies in the bottom of the huge Pannonian Basin encircled by the peaks of the Alps and the Carpathians.

programme.title: Wild Serbia
programme.desc: Serbia is in the heart of the Balkans, a “little Europe“ within Europe; with its rich variety of landscapes and natural beauties, it certainly does this name justice. programme.desc: The world is full of giants, huge creatures that fill us with awe and wonder. Some are gentle giants. Others are deadly hunters. There are different ways of defining ‘big’ - biggest in volume, or the biggest of their kind. But one thing is for sure, the huge animals of this world are fascinating, diverse and beautiful.

programme.title: World War A - When Aliens Attack
programme.desc: Scientists are already looking feverishly for evidence of extraterrestrial life. With the ExoMars mission, ESA will soon find life on Mars. If there are only tiny microbes, there could also be life in other places in the universe. But can life in space exist at all? The exobiologist Jean-Pierre de Vera collects microorganisms around the world and tests them in his Mars simulation laboratory. Can they survive under the deadly conditions of Mars? Researchers believe there are planets on which alien life can exist. In 1991 the Swiss astrophysicist Michel Mayor discovered the world's first exoplanet. Since then, about 3,000 planets have been detected outside our solar system. Heike Rauer from the German Aerospace Center is looking for habitable planets. Will she find a second earth? The European Southern Observatory is also searching for life in space, building the largest telescope in the world. In the next 20 years the E-ELT should be able to prove the existence of life on distant planets. How would extraterrestrials look? Some scientists suspect that they may well resemble us humans. Under other environmental conditions, alien life could also arise completely differently. It could be formed from methane and silicon. Different gravity would form alien bodies completely differently. Could extraterrestrials send us messages? programme.desc: She commanded armies and built warships. She was ruthless with rivals and quick to eliminate traitors. She spoke at least nine languages, received diplomats and negotiated with kings. But the last woman to rule Egypt is a legend today because of her powers of seduction.

programme.title: Elizabeth I
programme.desc: In an era dominated by men, Queen Elizabeth I was the only woman. She ruled England for 45 years, laying the foundation for the British Empire, and when she died in 1603 she gave her name to an entire epoch: the Elizabethan Age. Nobody would have thought this possible when she was younger – least of all herself.

programme.title: Queen Louise of Prussia
programme.desc: Some countries attain crucial characteristics under female rule, such as the England of Queen Elizabeth I and the Russia of Catherine the Great. And then there are women who do not rule and yet manage to leave their mark on their land, their era. One of these, known as the Queen of Hearts during her lifetime, was Louise of Prussia. Though she had no official political or military power, she wielded influence over the men who did - predominantly her husband King Frederick Wilhelm III - and she had the stature and style to become a symbolic figure.

programme.title: The Leaden Age
programme.desc: In the mid-fifties Franco's foreign policy successes opened up new perspectives for Spain. After years of stagnation the country was now moving forwards. Thus, Franco's rule was legitimized. Resistance fell silent. The dictator sat firmly in the saddle. But along with the new friends, new influences also entered the country.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Silk Road
programme.desc: China - the “Middle Empire” has long been thought to have developed completely independently of the West. Historic writings from as far back as the fourth pre-Christian millennium document the image of an isolated China, which has apparently evolved without any noteworthy boundary points to the West.

programme.title: Secret Societies

Were the people behind the 9/11 attacks really fanatical Muslims or did the American government play a part? Could Jesus have had descendants, as some authors speculate? programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: For most of our history, people have fallen victim to crippling disease, and not had a clue where it came from. programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Is the Honeymoon period over already? The rumor mill has it that Lisa (Eva Gabor) has packed up and left Oliver (Eddie Albert). Actually, she went back to New York to close up their penthouse apartment. And Mr. Haney is up to his old tricks!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) calls in a roofer, a plumber and agricultural expert Hank Kimball (Alvy Moore). All of them give the same appraisal of his farm: it's a disaster! Meanwhile, Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) has a few chickens he'd like to rent out!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The Douglases are awaiting the arrival of their furniture and they don't know it, but Oliver's mother is on her way, too. But when the furniture is accidentally delivered to Mr. Haney's new place, he tries to sell their own possession back to them.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Planting season ends in three weeks and Oliver has yet to get his land plowed. Meanwhile, Uncle Joe (Edgar Buchanan) needs a new shotgun before duck hunting season starts and schemes to solve both of their problems...without Oliver knowing it.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) sends a sample of his soil to the State Scientific College, a report comes back that his farm contains ingredients never before found in soil. Could his soil problems just be cosmetic? Eleanor Audley guest stars.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: You Can't Plug In A 2 With A 6
programme.desc: Relying on statistics provided by the Department of Agriculture, Oliver (Eddie Albert) decides to plant wheat. But when he goes to Drucker's to buy seed, he learns the other farmers have a unique way to predict the best crop�Mrs. Ziffel's lumbago.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Don't Call Us, We'll Call You
programme.desc: After some wheeling and dealing and mending a riff between Mr. Kimball and his mother, Oliver (Eddie Albert) finally has a phone installed, but the Hooterville Phone Company installs it directly outside his bedroom window...on top of the phone pole.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) plants his entire 160 acres with wheat, only to hear from The Crabwell Corners Conservation and Stabilization Committee, a local farm organization, that he was only permitted to grow eight acres of wheat�because of Mr. Haney.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The cow that Oliver (Eddie Albert) bought from Mr. Haney is pregnant. Afraid that Haney will claim the new calf, Oliver and Eb decide to keep it secret...only to have the people of Hooterville think that it is Lisa (Eva Gabor) who is expecting!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's the Douglases' wedding anniversary and, after initially pretending not to remember, Oliver (Eddie Albert) makes clear that he knows the date very well, he just can't remember exactly how many years he and Lisa (Eva Gabor) have been married.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is shocked that Hooterville has no beauty parlor, and the Ladies' Every-Other-Wednesday Afternoon-Discussion-Club nominates her to make it happen. Of course, Oliver's mother is happy to help, even if it means underhanded tactics.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Give Me Land, Lots Of Land
programme.desc: When Oliver's neighbor, Mr. Watson, decides to do some traveling, Oliver (Eddie Albert) buys the farm which adjoins his property, but not the house on it. Lisa (Eva Gabor) misunderstands and thinks the beautiful farmhouse is their new home.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: I Didn't Raise My Husband To Be A Fireman
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers the only requirement to join the Hooterville Valley Fire Department is that he must play a musical instrument. Meanwhile Lisa (Eva Gabor) tries her hand at cooking something besides "hotscakes" for breakfast.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Believing he will never get a moment's peace, Oliver (Eddie Albert) is annoyed when Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts a listing in the new phone book: "Oliver Douglas, Attorney at Law"�but it is a different story when no one calls for his services.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s apple crop is ready to be harvested, and he decides to take them to market himself and make a killing. Of course, getting to market before the price drops proves a little more difficult than Oliver anticipates.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) becomes enamored of Mr. Kimball (Alvy Moore), the county agent. However, though she feminizes herself and gets all gussied up, he refuses to go out with a girl named Ralph. Can Oliver solve the situation legally?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Six months is up! Now, Lisa (Eva Gabor) gets to decide whether she and Oliver (Eddie Albert) will remain on the farm or go back to New York and their Park Avenue lifestyle! Will this be the final straw for Green Acres?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Sam Drucker (Frank Cady) is leaving on a much-needed two-week vacation and talks Oliver (Eddie Albert) into assuming his duties as deputy sheriff. But Oliver soon learns enforcing the law isn't quite as easy as it looks.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Whatever you do, don't say her name and especially while playing checkers down at Drucker's! An old hag named Molly Turgiss (Renie Riano), who died twenty years before the Douglases (Eddie Albert, Eva Gabor) came to town, might be haunting them.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Never Look A Gift Tractor In The Mouth
programme.desc: It's a few days before Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s birthday, and Lisa (Eva Gabor) doesn't know quite what to get him�until the old Hoyt Clagwell goes kerflooey! So, she goes out and buys the biggest and fanciest tractor she can find.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Eb (Tom Lester) has a way with sick animals after Eb cures Arnold, the pig, and Alice, the chicken, and offers to put him through veterinary college. But will life in Green Acres ever be the same without Ed?!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: A horse follows Oliver (Eddie Albert) home, but every time he tries to show it to his wife, the horse disappears. Lisa (Eva Gabor) assumes that her husband is imagining things�and as more animals show up, Oliver begins to think so too.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) takes Oliver (Eddie Albert) to Pixley Superior Municipal Court and sues him for non-payment of a vital contract over the little matter of some rain�or lack thereof. Does Mr. Haney know who he's up against? Does Oliver?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The Third-Tuesday-of-Every-Month-Culture-Committee of the Every-Other-Wednesday-Afternoon-Discussion-Club decides that Hooterville needs some "culture" in the form of a symphony orchestra. And Lisa (Eva Gabor) may just know the perfect conductor.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver's (Eddie Albert) nephew Charles (Don Edmonds) arrives for a visit, and Oliver is completely shaken up when the boy turns out to be a long-haired, motorcycle-ridin', hippy-dippy type. But, boy, does he know a thing or two about engines.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.sub-title: You Ought To Be In Pictures

programme.sub-title: A Home Isn't Built In A Day

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Everything is topsy-turvy and henhouse hijinks ensue when one of the Douglas' hens is found to be laying square eggs! News of this kind gets around quickly, and the townsfolk all get in on the race to capitalize on the impressive novelty.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: El Amor Marca El Lugar
programme.desc: Para evitar que la editorial en la que trabaja sea vendida, Becca, una joven editora, tiene que viajar a Arcania con la famosa estrella de acción Lee para conseguir los derechos cinematográficos de la popular serie "Lover's Quest".

programme.title: La Bella Y La Bestia
programme.desc: Eric Landry es un hombre de corazón frío al que la gente ha apodado "la Bestia". Años de ira y amargura lo han consumido, convirtiéndolo en un hombre egoísta. Pero Belle Watson es exactamente lo contrario. Ella es cariñosa y amable. Trabaja duro para ayudar a su familia, a menudo sacrificando sus propias necesidades y deseos para satisfacer las necesidades de los demás. Cuando su padre rompe accidentalmente una valiosa obra de arte en la mansión Landry, Bella se ve inmersa en la vida de la Bestia. Haciendo todo lo posible por no dejarse intimidar por su mezquindad, Belles acepta trabajar para Eric en un esfuerzo por pagarle y salvar el trabajo de su padre. Ella descubre que podría haber más en Eric. ¿Encontrará al hombre dentro de la Bestia?

programme.title: Cambio de Amor
programme.desc: En su decimotercer aniversario de boda, James y Michelle se despiertan y descubren que han cambiado de cuerpo. Incapaces de volver a intercambiarse, se ven obligados a comprender lo que el otro vive a diario.

programme.title: No Me Llamen Cenicienta
programme.desc: La vida aparentemente perfecta de Indy es puesta patas arriba tras un accidente con Bryant, el cual le ayudará a descubrir quién es.

programme.title: Con Amor, Alaska
programme.desc: Cuando dos amigos de la infancia se reúnen gracias a una generosa herencia que otorga a sus corazones rotos mucho más de lo que esperaban: una segunda oportunidad para el amor.

programme.title: Amor Idéntico
programme.desc: Después de ser dejada en el altar, la Dra. Charlotte Hudson necesita escapar de la vida en su hogar. Ella se inscribe como voluntaria en una clínica de salud en un país tropical. Pero sus planes de escapar se frustran cuando se encuentra con el hermano gemelo de su ex prometido, Seth (un dentista), que también trabaja como voluntario en la clínica. Mientras pasan tiempo juntos, Seth se enamora de Charlotte, pero ella lucha por dejar de ver a su prometido cada vez que mira a Seth. El romance isleño la ayudará a liberarse del pasado y amar a Seth por quien es.

programme.title: La Receta Del Amor
programme.desc: Una ocupada cirujana regresa a casa para celebrar que su padre se ha convertido en alcalde. Pero tras un encuentro fortuito con el único médico del pueblo -y el soltero más codiciado-, es testigo de una verdadera compasión que podría ser la receta que este médico necesita.

programme.title: Encontrando El Amor En Charm
programme.desc: Una mujer Amish joven , que no está satisfecho con su camino en casa, visita un primo para el verano. Durante el verano , ella está expuesta a otro mundo , descubre la amistad y más. Pronto ella debe elegir y ponerse de acuerdo con la vida que ella quiere.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: International superstar Donnie Yen reprises his iconic role as the real-life kung fu grandmaster Ip Man. Master Ip, a new arrival in British-occupied Hong Kong, wants to open a martial arts academy to teach his unique Wing Chun style. A corrupt cabal of martial arts masters, led by Master Hung (Sammo Hung) refuses to allow him to teach in peace until he proves himself in a series of fights against the local master, which Ip does, in style. But even after earning the respect of the local masters, Ip’s troubles are far from over. Hong Kong under British rule is a new world of corruption and conflict between the Chinese locals and the British expats that run the city. When a Western-style boxer named “Twister” (Darren Shahlavi) comes to town to entertain the Brits, he insults Chinese martial arts in a horrifically violent way, and Ip is forced by honor to enter a brutal “King of the Ring” boxing match against Twister- and it’s East versus West in an amazing, knock-down drag-out fight to the finish.

programme.title: Baselines
programme.desc: Set in Los Angeles, this series follows Jamiel Chambers, a blue chip high-schooler on the brink of escaping the desperate poverty that has berated inner city America. After his junior year ends with him leading his team to a second place finish in the state's regional tournament, Jamiel is hand-picked to play in the city's annual summer league All-Star game. With college recruits swarming and pro agents hedging, the media circus leans in, peddling the question mark around his future like rabid bookies. It is this exposure that gets the attention of Nick Collins, a derelict from a disreputable family from neighboring Irvine. After his doomed-from-the-start plan to capitalize on Jamiel's notoriety ends in with fatal results, family members from both sides are pulled into a series of events which will not only effect Jamiel's trajectory, but will set up one of the most intense family feuds the city has ever witnessed.

programme.title: Money Moves
programme.desc: Money Moves is an in-depth, video podcast hosted by Tanya Sam. Each episode is dedicated to empowering black and brown communities to end the wealth gap by providing financial planning tips with expert guests, who share their successes and how they balance the money moves behind their names and businesses. How are we making moves to end the wealth gap? By highlighting the celebrities making significant money moves and giving a platform to experts in the financial literacy space, an opportunity to break the myths holding our communities back.

programme.title: Not Another Black Movie
programme.desc: Not Another Black Movie stars Damon Williams (Bad Boys of Comedy, Comic View, BET LIVE, The Tom Joyner Morning Show), Janet Hubert (The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air), Rodney Perry (The Monique Show, Who's Got Jokes) Jay Davis (Not Another Zombie Movie, Shots Fired), and Leon Rogers (WGCI, Comic View, Bad Boys of Comedy). - Not Another Black Movie is not only a spoof of a genre often associated with Tyler Perry films, but a satirical look at family dysfunction as well. Written by Jay Davis and Directed by Donte "Diesel" Williams, Not Another Black Movie addresses issues that effect many families whether they be rich or poor, black or white. Although we poke fun at some of the stereotypical roles portrayed in this genre, we hope to shed some light on problems that plague many families while giving you a good laugh.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Paper Tales
programme.desc: Animation series “Paper Tales” narrate to children audience in fascinating way amusing adventures of paper animals – a moose named Aristotle and a woodpecker named Knock-Knock – in paper land where everything is made only from paper. Merry adventures come together with entertaining insets “for crafty hands” when the audience learns how to produce all cartoon characters using paper, cardboard, scissors and glue. The project is supported with the site where all flat patterns are provided with the advices how to manufacture the paper world items.This is the way spectator gets involved into a peculiar game that brings out creative work and development of many useful practical skills, distracting kids from permanent attachment to a computer. The “Paper Tales” project is a fascinating and helpful alternative to computer-oriented pastime. The whole cartoon is accompanied by off-screen narrator’s text and exuberant flow of gags. Each episode is planned to last for 5 minutes (a version without insets – 4 minutes). Technique of performance is 3D computer graphics imitating paper application work.

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot
programme.desc: A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.

programme.title: Stardog & Turbocat
programme.desc: A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers
programme.desc: A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

programme.title: Cats
programme.desc: A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.

programme.title: Tall Tales
programme.desc: When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.

programme.title: Luis and the Aliens
programme.desc: A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

programme.title: Wild Wonders With Brooke
programme.desc: Brooke learns how man's best friend is playing an important role in protecting endangered wildlife, how their noses help them to find wildlife criminals, and a simulation of how they catch poachers.

programme.title: Wild Wonders With Brooke
programme.desc: Brooke heads to one of the world's oldest deserts and learns that it is full of life; the whole system is supported by a unique cold ocean current that she explores in the company of pelicans and seals.

programme.title: Wild Wonders With Brooke
programme.desc: Brooke spends time with her friend Joel, a seasoned wildlife vet; she learns about the wide variety of both interesting and dangerous patients and projects that he has to deal with.

programme.title: Wild Wonders With Brooke
programme.desc: Brooke journeys to the Kalahari research station where she joins a team of scientists researching meerkats; she learns what amazing animals these are and one even uses her head as a lookout point.

programme.title: Wild Wonders With Brooke
programme.desc: Brooke learns about one of the most important ecosystems on the planet -- the oceans; learning how predators, birds and reptiles all rely on healthy oceans.

programme.title: Wild Wonders With Brooke
programme.desc: Pangolins are the most trafficked mammals traded on the black market; Brooke meets a pangolin rehabilitation specialist and learns about their unique biology from people fighting to save them.

programme.title: Wild Wonders With Brooke
programme.desc: Brooke joins Julian Fennessy from Giraffe Conservation Foundation on a mission to learn about giraffe populations in Africa; she discovers the threats faced as they capture and GPS track the giraffes.

programme.title: Wild Wonders With Brooke
programme.desc: Wildlife such as elephants and zebras often come into conflict with humans; Brooke meets up with a wildlife veterinarian to capture and move these animals safely in order to avoid conflict.

programme.title: Wild Wonders With Brooke
programme.desc: Brooke discovers which ecosystem services bees perform and what it takes to maintain healthy bee populations; with the help of a removal specialist, Brooke safely moves the bees without harming them.

programme.title: Wild Wonders With Brooke
programme.desc: Large game are one thing, but now it's time for Brooke to learn different techniques used in transporting smaller species; she travels to help capture and relocate two small species.

programme.title: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Confronted with housing shortages and rising prices, architects around the world renovate existing buildings to create sustainable micro homes in some of the busiest city centers.

programme.title: Never Too Small
programme.desc: The micro-getaways, located in some of the most beautiful parts of Australia, incorporate all the comforts of a larger home in a small footprint.

programme.title: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Creating purposeful homes ensures the best use of limited space as cities continue to grow; exploring homes that have been meticulously crafted to reflect each life stage of their occupants.

programme.title: Never Too Small
programme.desc: With under 30 square meters of space, barely larger than the average living room, these homes have transformed from cramped spaces into functional, long-term dwellings.

programme.title: Never Too Small
programme.desc: As city space becomes more valuable than ever, designing smart, modern homes in a smaller footprint is becoming critical for future habitation.

programme.title: Never Too Small
programme.desc: From Italy to Hong Kong, these tailor-made micro homes reveal how unique, personal designs are not limited by space.

programme.title: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Multi-level designs bring new possibilities for small homes, filling spaces of increasingly odd shapes and sizes while combatting urban density.

programme.title: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Working with color and light is the key to making a small home feel spacious and open. Architects use creative color schemes and light shapes to uniquely expand micro spaces.

programme.title: Never Too Small
programme.desc: How some of the smallest spaces become livable homes; these unique, meticulously crafted creations reflect the very best in efficient design.

programme.title: Never Too Small
programme.desc: In constrained city centers, cleverly designed spaces with multifunctional rooms make these homes feel much larger than they are.

programme.title: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Creative expansion, above and below.

programme.title: Never Too Small
programme.desc: A look at how architects have managed to retain authenticity while revamping heritage homes for modern living.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: End Grain Glue Myths
programme.desc: A recent video discussed how much stronger end grain joints are than we assumed, but some folks misinterpreted the data.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Elevated Dog Bowl - WFC 2019
programme.desc: A fun project for your four-legged pals.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Edge Banding aka On The Edge
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to fix up ugly edges on your projects.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Ebony Plugs
programme.desc: We focus on pillowing ebony pegs, an adornment commonly found in Greene & Greene style furniture.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: French Cleat Storage System
programme.desc: A French cleat is as ingenious as it is simple. It involves securing a strip of wood with a 45 degree bevel to the wall, and then securing an opposing beveled strip on the back of a cabinet or anything you want to hang. Its incredibly strong and versatile. Its a great way to hang cabinetry and as you’ll see in this video, it can be used to make an awesome modular wall storage unit.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Fortnite Sign Via CNC
programme.desc: A CNC-cut Fortnite sign for my son's birthday!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Flexible Sanding Strip
programme.desc: The first time I saw a flexible sanding strip in action was while watching an episode of Woodworks going on almost 10 years ago. David Marks incorporates lots of curves in his work and the man knows a thing or two about making them. Since then, I have made numerous sanding strips in all shapes and sizes and my curves are about as perfect and smooth as they can be.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Flattening Workbenches and Wide Boards with a Router
programme.desc: The traditional method for flattening a workbench is to use hand planes and winding sticks. While some folks truly relish this labor of love, others prefer to delegate this grunt work to power tools. The power tool method is very similar to the action of a CNC machine. The router sled is very easy to make from scrap 3/4 inch plywood. The rails can be made from 2 by 6 construction-grade lumber.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Flatten Boards Wider Than Your Jointer
programme.desc: I'm going to show you two techniques that will help you keep your wide boards intact. Both methods utilize the planer for final flattening, but one method starts with a hand plane and the other starts with the jointer.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Fixing Common Woodworking Mistakes
programme.desc: Whether we like to admit it or not, mistakes will happen. Knowing how to repair them may make the difference between a nerve-wracking build and a relaxed one. So in this demo (recorded live), I'll show you some of the most common mistakes and errors I encounter and the various ways I like to fix them.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Fixing a Knot
programme.desc: Ever find yourself short on material and that one board you really need has a nice open knot in it? You could always go out and buy more material, but sometimes its just easier and faster to stabilize and repair the knot. And instead of trying to hide the knot, sometimes its just better to embrace it, and make it look look resinous and natural.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Finishing the Arts & Crafts Table
programme.desc: In this episode, Marc shows how to add a curve to the bottom rails and the sides of your arts & crafts table.

programme.title: Learn to Crochet
programme.desc: Have you always wanted to learn how to Crochet? Well now's your chance to have a lesson in the comfort of your own home. This easy to follow step by step programme will teach you the basics to get started and then move you onb to some simple projects such as making bunting and a crochet basket. You will find out what equipment you'll need, learn different crochet stitches and look at finishing techniques.

programme.title: Hooked for Life: Learn to Tunisian Crochet
programme.desc: Mary Beth Temple teaches the basics of Tunisian crochet.

programme.title: FaveCrafts: How to Make a Spring Wreath
programme.desc: Watch this DIY video tutorial to learn How to make a Spring Wreath. Adding colorful spring wreaths to your home is a fabulous way to make your space blossom with very little effort. Follow along with this home decor craft tutorial to create a stunning and bright project. This DIY craft is easy to make, and you can use just about any fabric you would like. Get started on your own DIY wreath for the most cheerful of seasons!

programme.title: FaveCrafts: Toolbox Father's Day Craft
programme.desc: While picking out the perfect gift for dad can be tempting, sometimes a gift card is an even better idea. As they say, it is the thought that counts! With this Toolbox Fathers Day Craft, you can learn how to make the perfect gift for dad. By creating a DIY craft to keep the gift card tucked into, you give your dad some handmade love and something useful at the same time. Plus, you could easily use this homemade box to wrap up some homemade candies, as well.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Today’s brand new Come Dine With Me Professionals heads to Birmingham, where our first hosts are Seafood restaurant The Oyster Club’s head chef Rosie and front of house Jess.

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: Coconut is a staple ingredient in Sri Lankan cuisine. Prominent chef Adam D'Sylva shares his ‘Smoked Trout Salad, Coconut Sambol & Pomelo,’ a light dish that’s big on flavour. Jerry Mai (chef) prepares a ‘Crab Curry,’ with a rich coconut base showcasing popular Sri Lankan spices. For dessert Diana makes ‘Watalappan,’ a beloved Sri Lankan staple.

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: Chinese cuisine is flavourful and diverse. Diana shows how easy it is to make a Yum Cha favourite at home as she prepares ‘Sesame Balls with Red Bean Paste Filling.’ Master Chef alumni and friend, Karlie Verkerk, shares her recipe for ‘Three Cup Chicken- San Bei Ji’- a simple, homestyle Chinese dish.

programme.title: Anna and Kristina's Grocery Bag
programme.desc: How can the most stressful meal of the year get crazier? Anna and Kristina throw a glitzy holiday soiree, and invite a chef, sommelier, and event planner to judge if it’s naughty or nice.

programme.title: Anna and Kristina's Grocery Bag
programme.desc: Anna and Kristina find themselves making a meatloaf mound and fishless sushi for Top Chef finalist, Sam Talbot – a judge with more sophisticated taste than these quirky dishes offer.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Bun and Co are kicking off the competition in Birmingham this week, where Head Chef Ruman and front of house manager Syeem are hoping their brand of Indian style fusion fast food will wow their guests. The boys have a great deal of banter and fellow restaurateurs Jojo and Toni from The Lion Sports Bar certainly enjoy the atmosphere. Though when Toni reveals her hatred of melted cheese, Paul and Liz from the Rafters are concerned for their menu.

programme.title: Cook Like An Italian
programme.desc: Let’s face it – when it comes to Italian food, carbs are king. Pizza, pasta, panini – it can feel impossible to enjoy Italian cuisine with a gluten-free lifestyle. But modern Italian home cooks have embraced gluten free culture and in this episode Silvia explores 3 very different ways of cooking Italian ‘Senza Gluten’!

programme.title: Cook Like An Italian
programme.desc: For Italians, if the pantry is stocked with classic and versatile ingredients, they will never go hungry again or spend a fortune ordering in. In this episode Silvia helps her friend Claudio prepare 2 delicious healthy pasta salads and cooks a mouth-watering Chicken Cacciatore for her teenage son and his best mate

programme.title: Ainsley's Food We Love
programme.desc: Ainsley takes inspiration from days beside the seaside. Starting with his “caribbean squash and chickpea roti with hot sauce yoghurt.” Bake Off winner, Candice Brown, brings all the fun of the fair with her naughty “toffee apple doughnuts.” Ainsley cooks up his take on a beachside classic for mate and comedian Alan Davies with his “crispy fish cakes,” “garden pea crush,” and “sweet potato wedges.” Olly Smith has hunted out the perfect wines for sipping by the seashore. And no trip to the beach would be complete without some ice cream. Luckily Ainsley has just the ticket with his “homemade honeycomb ice cream sundae with butterscotch sauce.”

programme.title: Anna and Kristina's Grocery Bag
programme.desc: Does the updated version of this 70’s classic that changed vegetarian cooking stand the test of time? Anna and Kristina get back to nature cooking with carob, soybeans, and bulgur!

programme.title: Karena & Kasey's Foreign Flavours
programme.desc: Karena and Kasey go off the beaten track in Fiji to learn more about the flavours of our Pacific neighbour. They finish the trip in a village near the lesser known town of Savusavu where they cook for a local group of village families.

programme.title: The Food Files
programme.desc: Let’s talk diets. From Atkins to Paleo, the tongue patch method and Beyoncé diet; you name it, we’ve got it!

programme.title: The Food Files
programme.desc: Why are snacks so incredibly addictive? Is it the salt? The crunchiness? We investigate the snack industry.

programme.title: Bake With Anna Olson
programme.desc: Nothing beats the smell of fresh bread coming out of the oven and these rustic styles will have you running to the kitchen to bake.

programme.title: Flat Out Food
programme.desc: Traditional foods that can be foraged or hunted have provided nourishment for the people on this land for thousands of years. Jenn learns about some of these ingredients and their uses

And no trip to the beach would be complete without some ice cream. Luckily Ainsley has just the ticket with his “homemade honeycomb ice cream sundae with butterscotch sauce.”

programme.title: Anna and Kristina's Grocery Bag
programme.desc: Does the updated version of this 70’s classic that changed vegetarian cooking stand the test of time? Anna and Kristina get back to nature cooking with carob, soybeans, and bulgur!

programme.title: Karena & Kasey's Foreign Flavours
programme.desc: Karena and Kasey go off the beaten track in Fiji to learn more about the flavours of our Pacific neighbour. They finish the trip in a village near the lesser known town of Savusavu where they cook for a local group of village families.

programme.title: The Food Files
programme.desc: Let’s talk diets. From Atkins to Paleo, the tongue patch method and Beyoncé diet; you name it, we’ve got it!

programme.title: The Food Files
programme.desc: Why are snacks so incredibly addictive? Is it the salt? The crunchiness? We investigate the snack industry.

programme.title: Bake With Anna Olson
programme.desc: Nothing beats the smell of fresh bread coming out of the oven and these rustic styles will have you running to the kitchen to bake.

programme.title: Flat Out Food
programme.desc: Traditional foods that can be foraged or hunted have provided nourishment for the people on this land for thousands of years. Jenn learns about some of these ingredients and their uses

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Today’s brand new Come Dine With Me Professionals heads to Birmingham, where our first hosts are Seafood restaurant The Oyster Club’s head chef Rosie and front of house Jess.

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: Coconut is a staple ingredient in Sri Lankan cuisine. Prominent chef Adam D'Sylva shares his ‘Smoked Trout Salad, Coconut Sambol & Pomelo,’ a light dish that’s big on flavour. Jerry Mai (chef) prepares a ‘Crab Curry,’ with a rich coconut base showcasing popular Sri Lankan spices. For dessert Diana makes ‘Watalappan,’ a beloved Sri Lankan staple.

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: Chinese cuisine is flavourful and diverse. Diana shows how easy it is to make a Yum Cha favourite at home as she prepares ‘Sesame Balls with Red Bean Paste Filling.’ Master Chef alumni and friend, Karlie Verkerk, shares her recipe for ‘Three Cup Chicken- San Bei Ji’- a simple, homestyle Chinese dish.

programme.title: Anna and Kristina's Grocery Bag
programme.desc: How can the most stressful meal of the year get crazier? Anna and Kristina throw a glitzy holiday soiree, and invite a chef, sommelier, and event planner to judge if it’s naughty or nice.

programme.title: Anna and Kristina's Grocery Bag
programme.desc: Anna and Kristina find themselves making a meatloaf mound and fishless sushi for Top Chef finalist, Sam Talbot – a judge with more sophisticated taste than these quirky dishes offer.

programme.title: Cook Like An Italian
programme.sub-title: Grandma hacks that make a difference
programme.desc: Every Italian cook has ‘grandma hacks’ or ‘party tricks’ passed down from their Mamma and it’s these little hacks that make all the difference. Most of these recipes you’ll be familiar with, but these slight twists make the cooking process faster and are bound to impress those guests you’ve been promising to have over for months!

programme.title: Cook Like An Italian
programme.desc: You cannot go wrong with these favourites which will of course be enjoyed by the whole family – even if you have some fussy eaters in the house! The ingredients are simple, yet full of flavour and the recipes have been refined to the point of perfection as they’ve passed down the generations.

programme.title: Wall of Chefs
programme.desc: The power of an ingredient should never be underestimated, and the home cooks feel it when working with speck in the Chef’s Fridge round and then while creating a restaurant-worthy Mac and Cheese.

programme.title: Bake With Anna Olson
programme.desc: Yay! Candy! A pastry kitchen can also include a confectionery, where candies are made. Here are some staples that every pastry chef learns to make.

programme.title: Flat Out Food
programme.desc: Saskatchewan produces the second most honey in Canada. Jenn learns about bees, how to make mead from honey and how honey can be used to elevate a dish.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Today’s brand new Come Dine With Me Professionals heads to Glasgow where it’s a family affair, as each restaurant is represented by a child and parent pairing! First up are Saffron By Paradise, where mother and son Mozhgan and Mehrab are pitting their Persian cooking against their fellow pros.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando una avería en el ferry provoca una escasez de gasolina en Yellowknife.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Duane consigue un contrato enorme para el Electra y ejerce una enorme presión sobre el mecánico Adam.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El Electra vuela a Alert, el asentamiento más al norte de la Tierra, lo que obliga a Adam y al nuevo gerente Duane a resolver las cosas.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Tratando de dejar su huella en Buffalo, Duane consigue dos contratos más de Electra.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La decisión de Duane de dejar al equipo de Electra sin supervisión mientras pasa tiempo en casa pone en peligro.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El mecánico Jimmy es enviado a un campamento minero del norte para crear una pista de aterrizaje de hielo en un lago remoto.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Problemas de motor en el C-46 durante la carrera en valle obligan a Devan a apagar un motor.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando Yellowknife y la comunidad de aviación del norte se ven sacudidos por tres accidentes en el espacio de un mes...

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe recibe una visita negativa de Transport Canada cuando los inspectores amenazan con cerrar la aerolínea.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Abrumado por la responsabilidad de entrenar a un nuevo rampie y luchando por salir de la caseta del perro de Joe.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de tomar el mando de un puente aéreo intenso y lidiar con la carga de Electra más fea que jamás haya visto.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: A solo unos meses de jubilarse, el capitán de Electra, Ray Weber, dirige a su tripulación en una misión de varios viajes.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando los compradores surcoreanos vienen a Buffalo para ver un bombardero de agua.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Buffalo tiene que llevar un bombardero de agua CL-215 a los compradores de Corea.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: En Corea del Sur, Cory y Justin se encuentran con el barco que entrega el avión bombardero acuático de Buffalo a nuevos compradores allí.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El aeropuerto Narsarsuaq de Groenlandia, conocido como uno de los enfoques más peligrosos del mundo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe y Mikey alquilan un helicóptero para una misión de rescate para recuperar el raro cordal de un Lockheed 10-A.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Justin y Cory están varados en Croacia mientras intentan completar la entrega de dos bombarderos de agua CL-215 a Turquía.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El copiloto novato Scott se enfrenta a su peor pesadilla cuando un motor Curtiss C-46 Commando y una baja niebla obligan a un aterrizaje aterrador. El joven y ambicioso volador Alex debe demostrar su valía cuando el piloto principal de Buffalo le da el control del Douglas DC-4 de 20 toneladas por primera vez.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Una racha de mala suerte hace que el 66 grados cumpleaños del piloto en jefe Arnie huya del infierno y amenaza con estropear su sorpresa de cumpleaños traviesa. El ayudante de rampa Jeremy está desesperado por ascender en los rangos, pero una novata podría arrojar una llave en sus planes, después de que la tripulación trabaja toda la noche para convertir el DC-4 en un tanque de gas volador.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando una falla de energía deja a Rankin Inlet expuesto a los elementos brutales del norte, el capitán Justin corre para entregar un generador de emergencia. El ayudante de rampa Jeremy intenta adelantarse a la compañera de trabajo Audrey entrenando a un nuevo empleado de la India para reemplazarlo. Y cuando la recesión pisa los talones de Joe, intenta negociar un acuerdo de $ 7 millones.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El mecánico Cory corre contra el reloj para convertir dos bombas de agua de corto alcance en aviones transatlánticos para el viaje épico a Turquía. Depende del ingeniero Adam sacar a la tripulación del C-46 de un atasco en una pista de aterrizaje remota en menos 40. Y cuando el capitán Devan y el copiloto Scott encuentran la amenaza de la cizalladura del viento en el famoso Bear Rock.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un vuelo charter cae por las grietas después de que los McBryans asisten a una boda familiar salvaje, y un furioso Joe saca al capitán Justin de los vuelos de prueba de Turquía para hacer el trabajo. La tarea de Justin es trasladar a un británico impaciente, su perro y todas sus posesiones mundanas a un remoto puesto avanzado del norte, pero el clima no está cooperando.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: AJ y Candace se casan en el Castillo de Hielo. Un frustrado Chuck intenta que la Electra le pague. Mikey, desconcertado, intenta hornear un pastel para el cumpleaños de Joe. Y en Terranova, una fuga de combustible, un curso de supervivencia aleccionador y un trágico choque sacudieron a la tripulación de Turquía. Cuando los fuertes vientos brinden la ventana meteorológica tan esperada.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La tripulación de Turquía hace el salto crítico sobre el Atlántico Norte. Pero en el camino a Portugal, un equipo se ve obligado a regresar. Sin potencia en un motor y sin forma de mantener la altitud, deben regresar a Santa María, donde el aeropuerto está en alerta de emergencia completa. Y Mikey y Scott buscan una nueva rampie, mientras que las esperanzas de Jeremy se desploman aún más.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Las tripulaciones C-46 y DC-4 compiten contra el deshielo primaveral para volar equipos mineros a una pista de aterrizaje en un lago congelado. Jeremy intenta alcanzar a sus compañeros rampies Audrey y Wilf. Y en el último tramo a Turquía, Arnie y Justin se enfrentan a algunos volcanes serios y al intenso tráfico aéreo del Mediterráneo.

programme.title: I'm in Love with a Church Girl
programme.desc: Miles Montego has it all - cars, boats, good looks, mansion, money, women, but more importantly, he has a past. Miles is a retired high-level drug trafficker who is now completely legitimate. Even though Miles has turned over a new leaf, the DEA can't seem to let him out of their sights. Miles' only downfall is that he is extremely loyal to his circle of friends and former colleagues who are not retired from the lucrative business. Struggling to keep on the right side of the law, Miles meets the girl of his dreams, but she's not the usual type of girl that he's used to dating. Vanessa is a church girl in every sense of the word. They are tested to their last ounce of faith and strength in God and each other. God continues to chip away at Miles through struggles from his past, having to live up to his reputation, feelings of unworthiness, the death of his mother, federal charges, his friends being indicted, the strain on his relationship with Vanessa, almost losing her in a near-fatal car accident, and finally the spiritual breakdown and one on one with God that brings Miles to his knees.

programme.title: Storm Hunters
programme.desc: A white monster charges up the Eastern Seaboard, and 80 million citizens are in its path.

programme.title: Un Esposo para Estela
programme.desc: Estela Morales es una joven huérfana dueña de una hacienda en ruinas y llena de deudas llamada "El Vendaval". Al morir su madre, Estela descubre que necesita un esposo para poder cobrar la herencia.

programme.title: Hechizo de Amor
programme.desc: Ligia Valderrama (Emma Rabbe) es la hermosa y engreída hija de una familia adinerada que vive en la capital. Pero existen secretos que yacen bajo la fachada de una familia feliz. La mujer que ella considera su madre no es la que le dio la vida, y su verdadera madre está internada en un manicomio. A algunas horas de camino del hogar de Ligia vive otra bella mujer con un pasado diferente. Ella es una pobre huérfana criada por una pareja que la adoptó cuando sus padres murieron. Ambas mujeres conocen y se enamoran de los hombres de sus sueños, pero a ninguna se le permite casarse. En cambio, ambas parejas son obligadas a separarse y por un tiempo pareciera que ambas jóvenes se casarían con la pareja de la otra.

programme.title: Harina de Otro Costal
programme.desc: Valentina y Víctor se culpan mutuamente por sus coqueteos. Lorenza revela a Calipe y Cándida que Valentina y Víctor fueron novios de niños, desatando la furia de Cándida.

programme.title: Las Amazonas
programme.desc: Emiro Lizárraga es un ambicioso y orgulloso propietario de un rancho de caballos llamado Amazonas. Emiro obtuvo su fortuna por medios ilegales, y tiene tres hijas Isabel, Carolina y Eloísa, además de haberse casado recientemente con su secretaria Elvira, una mujer coqueta, calculadora y ambiciosa. Las niñas no se llevan bien con la nueva esposa de su padre, lo que provoca conflictos. Isabel, la hija mayor, se siente atraída por Rodrigo, un joven veterinario divorciado y con dos hijas

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Vida Entera
programme.desc: Kotufa se presenta en la oficina de Salvador para contarle que su padre nunca estuvo secuestrado, entonces él se irrita y reprime a la joven, cuestionando su ética al hablar de su padre, pero ésta insiste que no sé trata de un invento, entonces él le pide pruebas. Yonder le dice a Philipe que consiguió trabajo en Exquisita de asistente de limpieza, cuando Clarita le avisa lo de la muerte del marido de Rosa, quien está en la morgue para reconocer el cadáver de su difunto marido. Guillermo le tiende una trampa a Carlota, ayudado por Diego, para que elija un perfume, y así saber cuál es el que ella prefiere.

Las niñas no se llevan bien con la nueva esposa de su padre, lo que provoca conflictos. Isabel, la hija mayor, se siente atraída por Rodrigo, un joven veterinario divorciado y con dos hijas

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Vida Entera
programme.desc: Kotufa se presenta en la oficina de Salvador para contarle que su padre nunca estuvo secuestrado, entonces él se irrita y reprime a la joven, cuestionando su ética al hablar de su padre, pero ésta insiste que no sé trata de un invento, entonces él le pide pruebas. Yonder le dice a Philipe que consiguió trabajo en Exquisita de asistente de limpieza, cuando Clarita le avisa lo de la muerte del marido de Rosa, quien está en la morgue para reconocer el cadáver de su difunto marido. Guillermo le tiende una trampa a Carlota, ayudado por Diego, para que elija un perfume, y así saber cuál es el que ella prefiere.

programme.title: Un Esposo para Estela
programme.desc: Estela Morales es una joven huérfana dueña de una hacienda en ruinas y llena de deudas llamada "El Vendaval". Al morir su madre, Estela descubre que necesita un esposo para poder cobrar la herencia.

programme.title: Hechizo de Amor
programme.desc: Ligia Valderrama (Emma Rabbe) es la hermosa y engreída hija de una familia adinerada que vive en la capital. Pero existen secretos que yacen bajo la fachada de una familia feliz. La mujer que ella considera su madre no es la que le dio la vida, y su verdadera madre está internada en un manicomio. A algunas horas de camino del hogar de Ligia vive otra bella mujer con un pasado diferente. Ella es una pobre huérfana criada por una pareja que la adoptó cuando sus padres murieron. Ambas mujeres conocen y se enamoran de los hombres de sus sueños, pero a ninguna se le permite casarse. En cambio, ambas parejas son obligadas a separarse y por un tiempo pareciera que ambas jóvenes se casarían con la pareja de la otra.

programme.title: Harina de Otro Costal
programme.desc: Valentina y Víctor se culpan mutuamente por sus coqueteos. Lorenza revela a Calipe y Cándida que Valentina y Víctor fueron novios de niños, desatando la furia de Cándida.

programme.title: Las Amazonas
programme.desc: Emiro Lizárraga es un ambicioso y orgulloso propietario de un rancho de caballos llamado Amazonas. Emiro obtuvo su fortuna por medios ilegales, y tiene tres hijas Isabel, Carolina y Eloísa, además de haberse casado recientemente con su secretaria Elvira, una mujer coqueta, calculadora y ambiciosa. Las niñas no se llevan bien con la nueva esposa de su padre, lo que provoca conflictos. Isabel, la hija mayor, se siente atraída por Rodrigo, un joven veterinario divorciado y con dos hijas
